title: On the spectral properties of generative denoiser Jacobians
abstract: arXiv:2609.36210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative denoising models, such as diffusion and flow-matching, learn to sample from complex distributions by training a deep neural network denoiser to recover clean data from noise-corrupted samples. While such models are typically compared on the quality of their synthesized samples, these metrics provide limited insight into how the underlying denoiser, which drives generation, differs. In this work, we propose to analyze the spectrum of the denoiser Jacobian as a tool to characterize these differences. Across pre-trained denoising models, we observe that better generative performance is associated with larger Jacobian eigenvalues. Motivated by this, we introduce a regularization scheme that controls the Jacobian spectrum by training the denoiser on perturbed inputs, with perturbations suppressing or amplifying Jacobian responses. translated_title: 论生成式去噪器雅可比矩阵的谱性质
translated_abstract: 生成式去噪模型，如扩散模型和流匹配模型，通过训练一个深度神经网络去噪器从受噪声污染的样本中恢复干净数据，从而学会从复杂分布中进行采样。虽然这类模型通常依据其合成样本的质量进行比较，但这些指标对于揭示驱动生成过程的底层去噪器之间的差异所提供的洞察十分有限。在这项工作中，我们提出分析去噪器雅可比矩阵的谱，以此作为刻画这些差异的工具。在多个预训练去噪模型中，我们观察到更好的生成性能与更大的雅可比特征值相关联。受此启发，我们引入了一种正则化方案，通过在受扰动的输入上训练去噪器来控制雅可比谱，其中扰动可以抑制或放大雅可比响应。在ImageNet上，我们测试了直接修改雅可比谱性质是否能带来生成性能的提升。
tldr: 本研究提出通过分析去噪器雅可比矩阵的谱来刻画生成模型之间的差异，发现更大的雅可比特征值与更好的生成性能相关，并提出一种通过扰动输入训练来控制雅可比谱的正则化方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes analyzing the spectrum of denoiser Jacobians to characterize generative models, finds that better generative performance correlates with larger Jacobian eigenvalues, and introduces a regularization scheme that controls the Jacobian spectrum by training denoisers on perturbed inputs.
